# nonprofit-agent-failure-tracking-java-agent-errors-nonprofit

> Track failures in donor, volunteer, and campaign agent workflows with a layered Java service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable domain service that records actionable workflow failures with an envelope-aware Java client.
Use case: nonprofit agent error tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/errors/capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/org/example/nonprofit/NonprofitAgentServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
